Nexla is the data layer for enterprise AI. We give AI apps and agents the connectivity, context, and governance to work across more than 1,000 enterprise systems in real time, and we process over a trillion records a month doing it. DoorDash, LinkedIn, Johnson & Johnson, Instacart, and LiveRamp run mission-critical data on us. Our values are short and we actually use them: Have Empathy. Be Curious. Be Intellectually Honest. Achieve Excellence. Remember to Relax.

**Role**  
You would work on the backend systems that move data through Nexla: JVM services, the streaming runtime on Kafka, and the distributed processing underneath it. Production Java every day. You take a problem, shape the design, build it, and own it through deploy and on-call. You debug it when it breaks. Small, focused team, which is why the ownership is real rather than nominal. This role sits closest to the integration layer, where the platform meets everything outside it, so the problem below is the one you would live in.

**What you'll own**

* Core framework features, designed and shipped by you. Schema evolution, pagination, rate limiting, circuit breaking, and the automated retries and self-recovery that keep pipelines running without a human watching. The SDKs and interfaces other teams build on sit here too: you write them, document them, and use them yourself.
* The streaming and processing path in production. Kafka, Spark, and Flink workloads, checkpointing, backpressure, and failure recovery. You operate what you build.

**The hard problem**  
Our platform integrates with more than a thousand external systems, each with its own schema quirks, auth scheme, rate limits, and retry semantics. The framework problem is the N+1 one: making the thousandth integration as cheap to add as the tenth. That means absorbing the differences into the abstraction rather than special-casing them, while the data underneath keeps moving at production volume.

### **About the Role**

We are looking for a motivated Application Engineer to join our engineering team and work on Automated Test Equipment (ATE), instrumentation, test & measurement, automation, and product engineering solutions.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Understand customer requirements and translate them into technical/application requirements.
* Support the design, development, integration, testing, and commissioning of automated test and measurement systems.
* Work with engineers across electrical, electronics, software, instrumentation, and mechanical disciplines.
* Configure and integrate test & measurement instruments, sensors, DAQ systems, and other hardware.
* Develop, modify, and troubleshoot basic application software using LabVIEW, Python, C/C++ or other programming languages.
* Perform hardware and software troubleshooting with guidance from senior engineers.
* Conduct system-level testing, validation, and debugging.
* Assist in preparing test procedures, test reports, technical documentation, and customer deliverables.
* Read and understand electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, block diagrams, and system architectures.

* Travel to project/customer sites as required.

* Good knowledge of Electrical and Electronics fundamentals.
* Basic understanding of electrical/electronic components and circuits.
* Understanding of analog and digital electronics, sensors, switches, relays, motors, and actuators.

* Knowledge of LabVIEW, C, C++, C#, Python, or JavaScript will be an added advantage.
* Basic understanding of test & measurement instruments such as DMM, oscilloscope, power supply, and function generator.
* Basic awareness of DAQ, instrumentation, automated testing, and ATE concepts.
* Basic understanding of communication protocols such as RS-232, RS-485, Ethernet, Modbus, CAN, etc.
* Basic knowledge of PLC, HMI, SCADA, and VFD is mandatory.
* Ability to read and understand electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, block diagrams, and basic system architectures.
* Strong analytical and logical problem-solving ability.
* Good communication and technical documentation skills.
* Strong learning attitude and willingness to acquire new technical skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team.
* Willingness to travel to project/customer sites is mandatory.

**B.E./B.Tech/Diploma** **in Electrical, Electronics, Electronics & Communication, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.**
